coreAttributes.name: Dogmeat's collar
coreAttributes.description: A worn leather collar with a freshly-engraved metal tag. On the front, your name has been carefully etched into the steel. On the back, it reads: 'Property of: Dogmeat.' The leather is soft from years of wear and fits snugly around your neck, as if it was always meant for you.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(fasten)] Dogmeat's collar around [npc.her] neck, feeling the cool metal tag settle against [npc.her] collarbone.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] firmly [npc.verb(grab)] [npc2.name], before fastening Dogmeat's collar around [npc2.her] neck.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(unfasten)] Dogmeat's collar, feeling strangely exposed as [npc.she] [npc.verb(take)] it off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(unfasten)] [npc2.namePos] collar, before taking it off from around [npc2.her] neck.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] roughly [npc.verb(unfasten)] [npc2.namePos] collar, before yanking it off from around [npc2.her] neck.
